# Brand Scaling

> Brand Scaling (legal name Brand Scaling Hacks LLC) is a DTC ecommerce growth agency that scales Shopify brands with Meta and TikTok ads, direct-response creative and conversion rate optimization. Founded by Gaurav Kapoor. 12+ years of ecommerce experience, $50M+ in Meta ad spend managed, 30+ niches, 150+ published case studies. Serves brands in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia.

Brand Scaling works with DTC and ecommerce brands doing about $20K to $2M+ per month in revenue with product-market fit, typically spending at least $10,000 to $20,000 per month on paid ads. Engagements start with a Brand Growth Audit: a 1-on-1 diagnostic of Meta ad accounts, creative performance, conversion bottlenecks and unit economics.

## Services
- [All ecommerce marketing services](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/services)
- [TikTok ads agency for ecommerce](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-ads-agency): creator ads, Spark Ads and in-feed campaigns
- [Meta ads agency for ecommerce](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/meta-ads-agency): Facebook and Instagram media buying, creative testing, Advantage+ scaling and Conversions API tracking, $50M+ managed spend
- [Ecommerce growth agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/growth): Meta, TikTok and Google media buying, creative, Shopify CRO and retention as one system
- [Performance marketing agency for ecommerce](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/): overview, results and process (Foundation, Test, Optimize, Scale)
- [Shopify growth agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/shopify-agency): store builds, product page optimization, offers, checkout and CRO testing
- [Direct-response video creatives and UGC](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/viral-creatives): 30 to 50+ angle iterations per month
- [TikTok Shop Agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/tiktok-shop-agency): TikTok Shop agency for DTC brands: shop setup, listings, affiliate creators and samples, LIVE shopping, GMV Max and Spark Ads, run on your real margins.
- [Google Shopping Ads](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/google-shopping-ads-agency): Google Shopping ads agency for DTC brands: Merchant Center feeds, Performance Max, brand vs non-brand split and target ROAS set from your real margins.
- [Ecommerce CRO Agency](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/cro-agency): Ecommerce CRO agency for Shopify brands: research, speed, product pages, bundles, checkout, A/B tests and post-purchase upsells built for paid traffic.
- [Klaviyo Email and SMS](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/klaviyo-email-sms-agency): Klaviyo agency for DTC brands: email and SMS flows, campaigns, segmentation and deliverability built to lift LTV so your paid ads can afford a higher CAC.
- [Affiliate Program Management](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/dtc-affiliate-program-management): DTC affiliate program management, done for you: creator recruiting, commissions, tracking, payouts, fraud checks and partnership ads on the best content.
- [Influencer Marketing](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/influencer-marketing-agency): Ecommerce influencer marketing agency for DTC brands: creator seeding, paid partnerships, whitelisted ads and usage rights, measured on new-customer CAC.
- [Creative Strategy](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/creative-strategy-agency): Ecommerce creative strategy for DTC ad accounts: angle research, a 45+ hook and angle matrix, briefs, weekly testing and iteration on winning ads.
- [Meta Ads Audit](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/meta-ads-audit): A Meta ads audit for DTC brands: account structure, CAPI and event match quality, creative fatigue, bidding and break-even ROAS, with a 90-day plan.
- [Retention Marketing](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/retention-marketing-agency): Ecommerce retention marketing for DTC brands: cohorts, post-purchase, subscriptions, loyalty, win-back, email and SMS, built to raise LTV and allowed CAC.
- [BFCM Ads Management](https://www.brandscalinghacks.com/bfcm-ads-management): Done-for-you BFCM ads management: Q4 planning, a creative bank, early access, peak campaign structure, cost controls and a December follow-on plan.
